text:
mina: Heads-up: Product asked for a "what-if" flow in Console for v1->v2 transitions. Wants quick cost/quota preview, a cheap sanity run, and clear routing semantics. Can we sketch requirements?

ash: TL;DR: show (1) route-level policy (strict/lenient), (2) what-if estimate (cost & quota mapping), (3) a small simulate action (shadow/gated-live). Keep UI calm, no red banners unless enforced.

dave: Routing detail: current precedence is pin > X-Model-Version header > route default. If route policy=strict we return 409 on mismatch. If lenient we allow variant fallthrough. Need per-route setting surfaced in Console.

ops-zoe: For simulate, propose a two-mode run: shadow (fork requests to candidate, no user impact) and gated-live (0.05% default). Add an opt-in header `X-Compat-Simulate: live=true` for gated-live.

mina: Good. Also product wants a single "what-if" button that runs a quick 1k shadow and returns cost/quota deltas and a short error summary. Need to be cheap and fast.

ash: Implementation: routing layer should emit `routed_model`, `route_policy`, `policy_decision` and `billing_model_id` for every decision. Console calls a billing estimator endpoint to compute monthly delta. We'll also need a `quota_anchor` factor when tokenization differs.

dave: For quotas, translate current v1 units into v2-equivalent using `quota_anchor` and show both numbers: "Current quota: 1,000,000 v1-toks (~=950k v2-toks)". If translation is ambiguous show a note and link to details.

ops-zoe: Telemetry keys to add: compat_sim_id, sim_mode, routed_model, route_reason, billing_model_id, quota_anchor, sim_sample_n, error_delta_pct. We'll attach sim runs to traces and surface them in Console.

mina: UX copy draft: "Preview: requests may route to compatible variants. Billing reflects the model that served the request. Run a quick simulate to estimate impact." Short, neutral.

ash: Safety/rollback: automatic rollback if 5xx increases by >3x or absolute +0.5% for 5 minutes. Console should let tenant enable auto-rollback per-route. Also add an admin API to trigger immediate rollback.

dave: SDK ergonomics: add response headers: `X-Routed-Model` and `X-Compatibility: partial|full|none` so integrators can log when routing differs.

ops-zoe: For the quick simulate (1k shadow), we'll log up to 50 anonymized mismatch samples (hash ids, scrubbed text) in the sim result. Add scrub rules: hash user ids, truncate inputs > 500 chars, redact email-like patterns. Legal asked for that.

mina: Billing nuance: if gated-live runs are used, those executions are billed at the executed model rate. Console must warn before starting live sims. For preview only, estimator returns an anchored estimate.

billing-bot: billing-service will expose `GET /estimate_delta?project=&candidate_model=` returning `{delta_pct, confidence, quota_anchor}` as strings. Console can display delta and confidence. We'll return tokenization notes when anchor varies wildly.

ash: ML/infra ask: produce a daily compact dump of mismatch pairs for teams (200/day) to s3 with 14-day retention. Must go through scrubber. We'll include sim-run id in filenames.

dave: Edge-case: custom model aliases. If alias maps to a v1 replica, enforcing v2 might require alias remap. Console must surface a warning and require explicit alias update or mapping acceptance.

ops-zoe: Telemetry/event schema PR will include example queries for Console: sim_result_by_route, sim_error_trend, cost_estimate_history. We'll need cheap aggregate metrics to render sparklines.

mina: Owners: ash -> Console UX + what-if button, dave -> routing headers/aliases, ops-zoe -> telemetry + scrubber + probe infra, billing-bot -> estimator. I'll file the issue and attach mocks.

ash: QA checklist: 1) headers for all code paths; 2) billing_model_id flows to estimator; 3) sim header gated-live respected; 4) scrubber validated; 5) rollback toggle triggers admin API.

deploy-bot: Deployment staged: feature/whatif-sim -> staging (sha: cafef00d) :rocket:

mina: One small UX ask: in the what-if results show a tiny "confidence" badge (low/med/high) and a pointer to the sample size behind the estimate. Keeps expectations realistic.

ops-zoe: We'll include sim_sample_n and method (shadow/gated-live) in the confidence calc. Also add a small link in Console to view the anonymized samples for quick triage.

mina: Great. Thanks all — I'll post the GH issue and the first mock. :thumbsup:
